headline: Kamindu Mendis struck 131 off 128 balls, his maiden ODI century, as Sri Lanka posted 325 and set Pakistan a target of 326 in the tri-series final at Gaddafi Stadium, Lahore, on Saturday, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Kamindu Mendis ne 128 balls par 131 runs banaye.

caption:
Final mein Pakistan ko 326 runs ka target!
Dawn ke mutabiq Gaddafi Stadium Lahore mein tri-series final mein Sri Lanka ne 325 runs banaye. Kamindu Mendis ne 128 balls par 131 runs ki innings kheli, jo un ki pehli ODI century hai. Salman Ali Agha ne 2 wickets liye.
Kya Pakistan ye target hasil kar lega? Comment mein batayein 👇
